name: Lukacho UI
summary: Animated React UI components for landing pages: dropdowns, tabs, charts, pricing, cursors, backgrounds.
description: A collection of animated UI components for React landing pages, built with Next.js, TailwindCSS and Framer Motion: dropdown menus, tab lists, an animated chart, animated pricing, background beams and lights, custom cursors, marquee, image swiper and more. Each component has a docs page with a live preview; the components are free and open source, with paid custom design services alongside.
